text: In-flight equipment malfunctions may affect either safety or the ability of the flight to proceed. Specialists may expect reports from pilots regarding VOR, ADF, low-frequency navigation receivers, impairment of air-ground communications capability, or other equipment deemed appropriate by the pilot. Question. Which of the following equipment failures would not affect flight safety or the ability of the flight? Question.
